title: Sunglasses Try-On Configurator
prompt:
Create a single HTML file implementing a sunglasses try-on product configurator using Three.js. Load the 3D model 'CesiumMilkTruck.glb' using GLTFLoader as a placeholder mannequin/display stand for the sunglasses.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at origin.
- Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.5) and a DirectionalLight at (5, 10, 7) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- Set renderer background color to #f0f0f0 with antialiasing enabled.
- Load 'CesiumMilkTruck.glb' and center it at the origin. Scale it so it fits nicely (scale factor 1.0 initially).
- Create a procedural sunglasses model using Three.js geometry: two torus shapes (radii 0.3, tube 0.05) as lenses, a bridge bar (cylinder), and two temple arms (thin boxes). Group them as 'sunglassesGroup'. Position sunglasses above the truck model at y=2.5.
- Add a ground plane (PlaneGeometry 20x20) at y=-0.5 with shadow receiving.
- Use OrbitControls for camera rotation, limited to polar angle [0.3, 1.5].

SUNGLASSES LENS STYLES (5 styles):
- 'classic': Black lenses (color #111111, opacity 0.8)
- 'aviator': Green tint (color #2d5a27, opacity 0.7)
- 'sport': Orange mirror (color #ff6600, opacity 0.6, metalness 0.9)
- 'fashion': Purple gradient (color #8b00ff, opacity 0.65)
- 'clear': Transparent (color #ffffff, opacity 0.2)

FRAME COLORS (4 options):
- 'black': #111111
- 'gold': #ffd700
- 'silver': #c0c0c0
- 'tortoise': #8b4513

UI ELEMENTS:
- A top bar with title 'Sunglasses Try-On' (id='titleBar').
- A lens style selector panel on the left side with 5 buttons (ids: 'btn_classic', 'btn_aviator', 'btn_sport', 'btn_fashion', 'btn_clear').
- A frame color selector panel on the right side with 4 buttons (ids: 'btn_black', 'btn_gold', 'btn_silver', 'btn_tortoise').
- A size slider (id='sizeSlider', range 0.5 to 2.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) that scales the sunglasses group.
- A 'Toggle UV Protection Info' button (id='btn_uv_toggle') that shows/hides a UV info panel (id='uvInfoPanel').
- A 'Reset' button (id='btn_reset') that resets all settings to defaults (classic lens, black frame, size 1.0).
- A price display (id='priceDisplay') that updates based on selections. Base price $49.99. Sport adds $20, fashion adds $15, aviator adds $10. Gold frame adds $30, silver adds $15, tortoise adds $10. Size multiplier: price * size.
- A 'Add to Cart' button (id='btn_cart') that increments a cart count displayed in a badge (id='cartBadge').
- An animation toggle button (id='btn_animate') that starts/stops the sunglasses rotating on the Y axis (speed 0.02 rad/frame).

STATE MANAGEMENT - Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- lensStyle: string (current lens style name)
- frameColor: string (current frame color name)
- sunglassesScale: number (current scale)
- price: number (current calculated price)
- cartCount: number (items in cart)
- uvPanelVisible: boolean
- isAnimating: boolean
- sunglassesRotationY: number (current Y rotation of sunglasses group)
- modelLoaded: boolean (true when GLB loaded)
- cameraDistance: number (distance from camera to origin)
- frameColorHex: string (hex color of frame)
- lensOpacity: number (current lens material opacity)
- selectedCount: number (total number of configuration changes made)

INTERACTIONS:
- Clicking lens buttons changes lens material properties and updates lensStyle.
- Clicking frame buttons changes frame geometry color and updates frameColor.
- Moving size slider scales sunglasses and updates price.
- All changes increment selectedCount.
- Price recalculates on every change.
- Animation toggle starts/stops Y-axis rotation.
- Reset button restores all defaults and sets selectedCount to 0.

Make sure the animation loop continuously updates window.__3D_STATE__.sunglassesRotationY and window.__3D_STATE__.cameraDistance.
physics_constraints: Sunglasses scale must remain in [0.5, 2.0]. Price must always be positive and correctly computed. Camera distance must remain positive. Rotation values must be NaN-free.
